Question 3
?

The cubic polynomial P(x) has roots x1=x2=−3,x3=1, and the coefficient of the cubic term is 5. Find P(x).

a
5x3−25x2−15x+45
b
5x3+15x2+5x−25
c
5x3+5x2+5x−25
d
5x3+25x2+15x−45
e
5x3+15x2+25x−45
